extDesc.message: Preview, pick, drag-reorder and batch-download the images on the current page in top-to-bottom order, auto-numbered 00, 01…

rescanTitle.message: Rescan the page (discards current selection and order)

pickHint.message: Click to toggle, drag to reorder. Numbers follow the order of selected images starting at 00 and are kept until the page reloads.

scanningLong.message: Scanning page (auto-scrolling to trigger lazy-loaded images)…

pageUnsupportedLong.message: This page can't be scanned (browser-internal pages and the Web Store don't allow scripts).

scanFailedLong.message:
Scan failed: $1
Reload the page and try again.

noImagesLong.message:
No matching images.
Try turning off the size filter or enabling background images in Settings, then rescan.

folderNameFirst.message: Give the folder a name first

noDirConfirm.message:
No save location chosen yet. Open Settings to pick a folder now?
(Chrome doesn't allow picking the Desktop itself — create a folder on the Desktop and pick that.)

needPermConfirm.message: The extension needs permission to access the “$1” folder. If you didn't see a prompt, you can click “Grant access” in Settings. Open Settings now?

needPermShort.message: Permission needed to access the “$1” folder.

hintBackground.message: You can close this window; the download continues in the background.

hintDirect.message: Writing directly into “$1”. You can close this window; the download continues in the background.

errNoType.message: image type unknown, skipped direct download

offscreenJustification.message: Write downloaded images directly into the user-chosen folder

optFilterSub.message: Excludes icons, avatars and tracking pixels

optDedupeSub.message: Keeps only the first image per URL

optAutoScrollSub.message: Reveals lazy-loaded images; long pages take a few extra seconds

optBgSub.message: Some sites use CSS backgrounds; scanning gets slower

optSaveDirect.message: Write directly into a folder I choose

optDirSub.message: Chrome doesn't allow picking Desktop, Documents or Downloads themselves. Create a folder on the Desktop (e.g. “Images”) and pick that; each download's folder is created inside it.

optNoteDirect.message: “Direct write” mode: pick a location once; each download creates a folder with the name you enter inside it and writes the images directly. It bypasses the browser's download list, so it doesn't interfere with download managers like IDM. After restarting the browser, the first download asks you to click “Grant access” once.

optNoteBrowser.message: “Browser download” mode: images go to a subfolder of Chrome's default download directory. If a download-manager extension like IDM is also enabled, its card shows a harmless filename-conflict notice.

noFsApi.message: This browser doesn't support writing into folders directly. Please use “Browser download” mode.
